description.value: Salt Spring Brewing Co. is a craft brewery tucked into the woods of Salt Spring Island, offering a tasting room and outdoor patio where visitors can sample core and seasonal beers. The brewery bills itself as 'a gem hidden in the woods' and hosts events including an annual Oktoberfest celebration. For cyclists touring the island, it serves as a scenic off-the-beaten-path destination to rest and enjoy locally made beer.
